description: This file defines the OAuth2 exception class for SuiteCRM's OAuth2 API, including constructor and methods for error details and logging level.

classes.name: OAuth2
classes.description: Custom exception class for OAuth2 errors in SuiteCRM, extending the base Exception class.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the OAuth2 exception with a message, code, and previous exception.

methods.name: getDetail
methods.description: Returns a string describing the reason for the exception.

methods.name: getLogLevel
methods.description: Returns the log level for this exception, set to ERROR.
